gloss: all show and no substance; deceptive appearance

definitions.gloss: all show and no substance; deceptive appearance
definitions.explanation: Something or someone that looks impressive on the outside but lacks real quality or substance.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{見掛|みか}け{倒|だお}しだ。
examples.english: That restaurant is all style and no substance.

examples.japanese: ⟦{立派|りっぱ}→立派：01093_rippa⟧な⟦{外観|がいかん}→外観：12154_gaikan⟧だ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{中身|なかみ}→中身：01483_nakami⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{見掛|みか}け{倒|だお}しだった。
examples.english: It had an impressive exterior, but the inside was a letdown.

examples.japanese: ⟦{高級|こうきゅう}→高級：08644_koukyuu⟧そうな⟦{包装|ほうそう}→包装：11932_housou⟧だった⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{中身|なかみ}→中身：01483_nakami⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{見掛|みか}け{倒|だお}し⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{安|やす}っぽかった→安っぽい：12236_yasuppoi⟧。
examples.english: The packaging looked luxurious, but the contents were cheap — all show and no substance.

notes:
USAGE:
{見掛|みか}け{倒|だお}し is used to criticize something that looks good on the surface but disappoints upon closer inspection. It can describe products, places, or people. Often used as a predicate with だ.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {見掛|みか}け{倒|だお}し⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧ (a product that's all show)
- {見掛|みか}け{倒|だお}し⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{終|お}わる (to turn out to be all show)

ETYMOLOGY:
From ⟦{見掛|みか}け→見掛け：08214_mikake⟧ (appearance) and {倒|だお}し (knocking down) — the appearance defeats expectations.
